tasks.title: Update a stale table of contents
tasks.spec: The table of contents is stale (two headings renamed, four added): make its entries match the headings (levels 1-3), each with the page number the heading lands on.

pylib.notes: python-docx has no layout engine, so it cannot know the page numbers. The usual fallback, run here, marks the TOC field dirty and sets w:updateFields so that Word rebuilds the TOC when the file is opened (after a prompt); the file itself keeps the stale entries.; oracle checks failed: entries_match_headings, page_numbers

tasks.title: Update PAGE, NUMPAGES and DATE fields
tasks.spec: Update the cached results of the body's DATE (today, yyyy-MM-dd), NUMPAGES (3) and PAGE (3, on the last page) fields, keeping them fields; say so when a stack cannot.

pylib.notes: python-docx has no layout engine: PAGE and NUMPAGES cannot be computed. The fallback, run here, writes today's date into the DATE field and sets w:updateFields so that Word refreshes every field when the file is opened (after a prompt).; oracle checks failed: numpages, page

tasks.title: Render pages 1-3 to PNG (accepted and tracked views)
tasks.spec: Render pages 1-3 to PNG at 100 dpi, the accepted view into OUT/accepted/ and the tracked-changes view (insertions and deletions visible) into OUT/tracked/.

tasks.title: Page number of each heading

pylib.notes: python-docx has no layout engine: it cannot tell on which page a paragraph lands (Paragraph.rendered_page_breaks only reads the page breaks Word cached at its last save, and this file was not last saved by Word).
